score.disclaimer: This score summarizes local checks that could be evaluated. It is not a Google ranking score, an indexation status, or a traffic estimate.

checks.title: Title is missing
checks.description: The page has no rendered title and no title element with text. Search engines may invent a title from other page content.
checks.recommendation: Add one descriptive title element that states the page topic in plain language.

checks.title: Title length was not evaluated
checks.description: There is no title to measure.

checks.title: No titles were available to compare
checks.description: Raw and rendered titles were both absent.

checks.title: Duplicate titles were not evaluated
checks.description: No title elements were collected.

checks.title: Meta description is missing
checks.description: No meta description was found. Search engines often write their own snippet from page content. A description is still useful as a suggested snippet.
checks.recommendation: Add a unique meta description that summarizes the page for a person deciding whether to open it.

checks.title: Description length was not evaluated
checks.description: There is no meta description to measure.

checks.title: No duplicate meta description
checks.description: A single description name was found, or the description is absent.

checks.title: No noindex directive in meta tags
checks.description: Meta robots, googlebot, and bingbot tags do not contain noindex or none. HTTP X-Robots-Tag and robots.txt were not read in this local pass, so this is not a full indexability verdict.

checks.title: No conflicting index directives
checks.description: Meta robots directives do not ask for both index and noindex.

checks.title: Viewport meta tag is missing
checks.description: Without a viewport tag, mobile browsers may lay the page out as a desktop page.
checks.recommendation: Add a viewport meta tag, commonly width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

checks.title: Character encoding is not declared in the collected tags
checks.description: No charset was found on a meta tag. The HTTP Content-Type header may still declare one, and that header was not read in this pass.
checks.recommendation: Declare UTF-8 early in the document if the response header does not already do so.

checks.title: No meta refresh
checks.description: No meta refresh directive was found.

checks.title: Canonical link is missing
checks.description: No rel=canonical link was found. A canonical helps when the same content is available at more than one URL. It is not required for every page.
checks.recommendation: Add a canonical link to the preferred URL when this content can be reached more than one way.

checks.title: Canonical URL was not evaluated
checks.description: There is no canonical link to validate.

checks.title: Duplicate canonicals were not evaluated
checks.description: There is no canonical link to compare.

checks.title: Canonical shape was not flagged
checks.description: No fragment or relative canonical was collected. A canonical is a preference, not a search engine's selected URL.

checks.title: Very little visible text
checks.description: 0 words were counted with Unicode word boundaries. Short pages can be complete, especially for tools and navigation. This is not a Google ranking threshold.
checks.recommendation: Add the explanation a visitor needs, or ignore this warning when the page is intentionally short.

checks.title: H1 is missing
checks.description: No H1 was found in the rendered document. A page can be valid without an H1, but a single descriptive H1 helps people and assistive technology understand the topic.
checks.recommendation: Add one H1 that describes the page.

checks.title: Multiple H1s were not evaluated
checks.description: There is no H1 to compare.

checks.title: Empty headings were not evaluated
checks.description: No headings were collected.

checks.title: Heading order was not evaluated
checks.description: No headings were collected.

checks.title: No duplicate heading text
checks.description: Identical text was not repeated at the same heading level. Repeated section labels can still be legitimate.

checks.title: Anchor text was not evaluated
checks.description: No links were collected.

checks.title: No HTTP links on this HTTPS page
checks.description: Collected links that resolved to HTTP were not found. Resources other than links can still be insecure.

checks.title: No JavaScript links
checks.description: No javascript: links were collected.

checks.title: Image alternatives were not evaluated
checks.description: No images were collected.

checks.title: Empty alt text was not evaluated
checks.description: No images were collected.

checks.title: Broken images were not evaluated
checks.description: No images were collected.

checks.title: Image display size was not evaluated
checks.description: No images were collected. File size is not measured.

checks.title: Page uses HTTPS
checks.description: The collected page URL uses https.

checks.title: HTTP status was not exposed
checks.description: The browser did not provide a navigation status for this document. A missing status is not treated as success.

checks.title: Redirect chain was not exposed
checks.description: The browser did not report how many redirects the navigation followed. Individual hops, status codes, and headers are not available without an optional network trace.

checks.title: Response headers were not collected
checks.description: Headers stay unknown until you run the optional site check. A missing header list is not a pass.

checks.title: robots.txt was not requested
checks.description: robots.txt stays unknown until you run the optional site check. A page can be blocked there even when the meta robots tag allows indexing. This result is not a pass.

checks.title: XML sitemap was not requested
checks.description: Sitemaps stay unknown until you run the optional site check. Missing this check is not evidence that a sitemap is absent.

checks.title: Broken links were not requested
checks.description: Links stay unchecked until you run the optional site check. A link is not treated as healthy because it was not fetched.

checks.title: Redirect hops were not requested
checks.description: The hop list comes from the optional site check. Navigation timing still supplies the redirect count when the browser exposes it.

checks.title: Search index status is unknown
checks.description: This toolkit cannot tell whether Google, Bing, or another search engine has indexed the URL. Index coverage requires data from that search engine.

evidence.label: what this check can see
evidence.value: On-page meta robots only. X-Robots-Tag and robots.txt stay unknown until the optional site check.

checks.title: Open Graph title is missing
checks.description: No Open Graph title was found. Sharing previews may be incomplete.
checks.recommendation: Add Open Graph title when this page is meant to be shared.

checks.title: Open Graph description is missing
checks.description: No Open Graph description was found. Sharing previews may be incomplete.
checks.recommendation: Add Open Graph description when this page is meant to be shared.

checks.title: Open Graph image is missing
checks.description: No Open Graph image was found. Sharing previews may be incomplete.
checks.recommendation: Add Open Graph image when this page is meant to be shared.

checks.title: X card type is missing
checks.description: No X card type was found. Sharing previews may be incomplete.
checks.recommendation: Add X card type when this page is meant to be shared.

checks.title: Document language is missing
checks.description: The html element has no lang attribute. Screen readers and language detection then have to guess.
checks.recommendation: Set the html lang attribute to the language of the page.

checks.title: Hreflang syntax was not evaluated
checks.description: No alternate links with hreflang were collected. This does not prove the page lacks translations.

checks.title: Duplicate hreflang was not evaluated
checks.description: No hreflang links were collected.

checks.title: Reciprocal hreflang was not evaluated
checks.description: No hreflang links were collected.

checks.title: Hreflang self-reference was not evaluated
checks.description: No hreflang links were collected.

checks.title: Accessibility sample was not collected
checks.description: The page snapshot did not include the accessibility sample. No accessibility result is treated as a pass. Automated checks cannot prove WCAG conformance even when they run.

checks.title: No JSON-LD scripts were found
checks.description: No JSON-LD script was collected. Microdata and RDFa are reported separately when present. Absence of JSON-LD is not a ranking error, and extraction is not rich-result eligibility.

checks.title: Rich-result fields were not compared
checks.description: JSON-LD was missing or did not parse, so the local field list was not applied. This is not an official rich-result test.

checks.title: No Microdata was extracted
checks.description: Nothing in this format was collected from the rendered page. This is not a pass, and it is not rich-result eligibility.

checks.title: No RDFa was extracted
checks.description: Nothing in this format was collected from the rendered page. This is not a pass, and it is not rich-result eligibility.

checks.title: Largest Contentful Paint is unavailable
checks.description: Browser-observed LCP from the current page load. This is not Chrome UX Report field data.

checks.title: Cumulative Layout Shift is unavailable
checks.description: Browser-observed layout-shift total for this page load, when the browser exposed the entries. This is not field data.

checks.title: Interaction to Next Paint is unavailable
checks.description: INP needs interaction entries. If the browser did not expose a value, the metric is unavailable and is not treated as a pass.

checks.title: PageSpeed Insights was not requested
checks.description: RankMiso does not call the PageSpeed Insights API and does not invent a lab or field score. LCP, CLS, and INP above are this browser's observations for the current page load, or unavailable.

recommendations.text: Add one descriptive title element that states the page topic in plain language.
Add one H1 that describes the page.
Add a unique meta description that summarizes the page for a person deciding whether to open it.
Add a viewport meta tag, commonly width=device-width, initial-scale=1.
Declare UTF-8 early in the document if the response header does not already do so.
Add a canonical link to the preferred URL when this content can be reached more than one way.
Add the explanation a visitor needs, or ignore this warning when the page is intentionally short.
Set the html lang attribute to the language of the page.
Add Open Graph title when this page is meant to be shared.
Add Open Graph description when this page is meant to be shared.
Add Open Graph image when this page is meant to be shared.
Add X card type when this page is meant to be shared.

content.readingTimeBasis: Estimate at 200 words per minute. This is an editorial average, not a measurement of a specific reader.

metadata.titlePixelBasis: Estimated at 7.5px per ASCII character and 14px per other character. This is not a browser text measurement.
